### Cognitive Tools Available

```python
# Topology Manager - Semantic navigation
from scripts.cognitive.topology_manager import TopologyManager

topology = TopologyManager()
# Find code by concept, not path
relevant_files = topology.find_by_concept("test failures")
optimal_path = topology.find_optimal_path("source", "target")

# Cache Manager - Multi-layer cache access
from scripts.cognitive.cache_manager import CacheIntelligence

cache = CacheIntelligence()
# Query cache intelligently
cached_results = cache.query("pr_3248_test_results")
cache.optimize()  # Get optimization suggestions

# Hash Tables - High-performance lookups
from src.codex.utils.hash_table import RobinHoodHashTable, CuckooHashTable

# O(1) guaranteed lookups
cache_lookup = CuckooHashTable()

# QEC - Quantum error correction for decisions
from scripts.cognitive.qec_complete import QECQuantumDecisionEngine

qec = QECQuantumDecisionEngine(k1=0.35)
decision = qec.make_decision(
    options=["fix A", "fix B", "refactor"],
    context={"similar_fixes": [...]}
)
# 99.9% accuracy, verified quantum advantage
```
